description: This file is a PHP web page that provides a user interface for viewing and managing troubleshooting logs, including system, event, and firewall logs, with options for filtering by time frame and dynamically loading log data via AJAX.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts the appearance and headers of the current visible data table, setting a summary and assigning header IDs to table headers and cell headers for accessibility.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to fetch log data based on selected mode and time frame, then populates the corresponding table with results.
